trial_court: District Court, Lakhimpur, North Lakhimpur, Title Suit(D) Case No.63/2022
case_name: Dr Parismita Sarma vs Dr Sanjeeb Kalita
facts_of_case: Petitioner and respondent married in 2021. Respondent filed divorce proceedings under Hindu Marriage Act, 1955. Petitioner seeks transfer of case to Family Court, Kamrup(Metro).

legal_principles.principle: Every petition under the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 shall be presented to the District Court within the local limits of whose ordinary original civil jurisdiction.
legal_principles.held: A perusal of the said Section shows that every petition under the Hindu Marriage Act,1955 has to be presented to the District Court within the local limits of whose ordinary original civil jurisdiction...

legal_principles.principle: The respondent's residence at the time of presentation of the petition is a factor in determining the court to which the petition shall be presented.
legal_principles.held: In case the wife is the petitioner, where she is residing on the date of presentation of the petition...

outcome.final_order: Case transferred to the Court of the Principal Judge, Family Court, Kamrup(Metro) at Guwahati.

use_for_drafting: practical tips for family court proceedings
